Section 2 - Financial Information Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition. On July 23, 2026, Dow Inc. issued a press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated herein by reference, announcing results for the second quarter of 2026. The information contained in this report, including Exhibit 99.1 attached hereto, is being furnished and shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or otherwise subject to the liabilities of Section 18. Furthermore, the information contained in this report shall not be deemed to be incorporated by reference into any registration statement or other document filed pursuant to the Securities Act of 1933, as amended. Section 9 - Financial Statements and Exhibits Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits. (d) Exhibits. The exhibit listed on the Exhibit Index is incorporated herein by reference. \begin{tabular}{cc} Exhibit No. & Exhibit Description \\ 99.1 & Press release issued by Dow Inc. on July 23, 2026, announcing results for the second quarter of 2026. \\ 104 & Cover Page Interactive Data File. The cover page interactive data file does not appear in the Interactive Data File because its XBRL tags are embedded with the Inline XBRL document. \\ \end{tabular} Signature Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized.
